extDescription.message: Finds videos on any site and downloads them with sound via yt-dlp + ffmpeg (local native host).

hint.message: Click to analyse this page's URL via yt-dlp.

manualPlaceholder.message: or paste a video / m3u8 URL manually

emptyDetected.message: Nothing detected yet. Start playing the video on the page.

noActiveTab.message: No active tab with a URL.

badManualUrl.message: Enter a full URL starting with http(s)://

notFound.message: No video found. The site may not be directly supported by yt-dlp — try analysing one of the detected streams above.

hostConnFailed.message: Could not connect to the native host. Install it (host/install_host.js).

hostNoAnswer.message: host is not responding (not installed or fails to start)

hostDisconnectedMsg.message: Connection to the native host was lost. Restart the browser or reinstall the host.

setupText.message: Downloads are performed by a small app on your computer. Two clicks to install — no admin rights.

setupStep2.message: 2. Unzip it and run Установить.bat inside

setupNotPublished.message: The package is not published yet — the link appears after the first release.

mReplacedDownload.message: Previous job interrupted — starting a new download.

mBadUrl.message: Invalid link: expected an http(s):// URL

mLaunchFail.message: Could not launch yt-dlp. Make sure yt-dlp.exe is in the host/bin folder.

mOutdirFail.message: Could not create the output folder

mParseFail.message: Could not parse the yt-dlp response

optSubfolderHint.message: Files are saved to Downloads\<subfolder>. Leave empty to save straight into Downloads.
